temporal_state_chain.observed: Marilyn has been unusually quiet and withdrawn over the past few days, which is uncharacteristic; during a busy week at the bank, Carolyn asks if she is alright, and Marilyn says she is overwhelmed by work and personal stuff and thanks Carolyn for asking.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Marilyn is normally engaging and had not seemed to have a major problem; her recent quietness might just be temporary or related to the busy week.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes: Marilyn is not simply quiet by chance; she is overwhelmed by work and personal issues, though she does not give details.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Marilyn is under stress and may need support, but she is willing to acknowledge it while keeping details private.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Concerned, empathetic, and curious about Marilyn's well-being.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Offer support and be available to talk without pushing Marilyn to disclose more than she wants.

temporal_state_chain.observed: After Carolyn's initial approach, Marilyn was curt in a subsequent interaction; when Carolyn shares her own tough experiences and says talking can help, Marilyn apologizes if she seemed off and explains she has had a hard week.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Marilyn is overwhelmed by work and personal issues; she accepted Carolyn's initial concern, so Carolyn is unsure why Marilyn later seemed curt.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes: Marilyn's curtness was likely caused by her hard week rather than by Carolyn overstepping; Marilyn appreciates Carolyn's openness and apologizes.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Marilyn is not upset with Carolyn; she is under strain but receptive to support and willing to smooth things over.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Initially confused and hurt, then reassured, relieved, and empathetic.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Clear any misunderstanding, show support, and continue building a supportive connection with Marilyn.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Marilyn responded positively to Carolyn's openness, and when Carolyn invites her to a small weekend get-together, Marilyn says it sounds lovely, thanks her, and says she would love to join.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Marilyn appreciated Carolyn's openness and apologized for seeming off; Carolyn feels relieved and hopeful about their budding friendship.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes: Marilyn is interested in connecting outside work and accepts Carolyn's social invitation enthusiastically.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Marilyn values the friendship and wants to spend time with Carolyn; their bond seems to be strengthening.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Strengthen the friendship by hosting the gathering and welcoming Marilyn into her social circle.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Despite friendly interactions outside work, Carolyn perceives Marilyn as still maintaining professional distance at the bank; when Carolyn raises this, Marilyn says she did not realize it, apologizes if it seemed that way, and agrees they should talk and improve collaboration.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Marilyn is friendly outside work and accepted Carolyn's invitation; their friendship seemed to be growing.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes: Marilyn may unintentionally keep a professional distance at work, but she is open to discussing it and improving their collaboration.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: The work distance may be a misunderstanding; Marilyn is willing to address the dynamic and collaborate better, though Carolyn remains aware of professional boundaries.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Disappointed and concerned before the conversation, then cautiously relieved and slightly optimistic after Marilyn's response.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Talk through the work dynamic, clarify expectations, and improve their professional collaboration.

temporal_state_chain.observed: When Carolyn proposes teaming up on the new project proposal, Marilyn says it is a great idea, is glad they had the talk, and looks forward to working more closely.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: After their private meeting, Carolyn believes they have cleared the air and understand each other's professional expectations and personal boundaries; she feels content and optimistic.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes: Marilyn agrees enthusiastically and confirms she wants to work more closely with Carolyn.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Their relationship and collaboration are aligned and positive; Marilyn is eager to partner with Carolyn.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Team up with Marilyn on the new project proposal and further their professional partnership.
